what: The re-check ledger (AGENTS.md "Findings and fixes", rule 8; EXEC-RECHECK-LIST, the user 2026-11-24): one row per finding whose fix an agent other than its author must test out, across executions, with its re-checks. The one source of RECHECK.md (python3 scripts/recheck_doc.py --write). A fix no other agent tested out enters here in the same commit as the fix, status waiting; an approved re-check takes its items from here, gives its agents the original finding, and its results update the row (recheck, status) in the same task. The 422 rows of the step-8 ledger of EXEC-MU-ACCOUNTS moved in on 2026-11-24 (from step8_ledger; verification/records/step8_ledger.json keeps that build's notes, groups and critic); the rows from scan came from the ERRORS_AND_SOLUTIONS.md and EXEC.md entries that said their fix was tested by its author only.

fields.key: unique: the run that found it plus the finding id (errors/<M id> when no checker found it)
fields.execution: the EXEC.md execution the row belongs to (the step-8 rows: EXEC-MU-ACCOUNTS, step 8)
fields.area: the group RECHECK.md lists it under, in plain Indonesian
fields.run: the workflow run(s) whose journal holds the finding as its checker wrote it; empty when no checker found it
fields.finding_id: the id the checker gave it
fields.title: a short name of the finding
fields.finding: the original finding as its checker wrote it (run, agent, id, severity, verdict: text), or the ERRORS entry's symptom when no checker found it; empty for a row moved from the step-8 ledger, whose title and recheck_action stand for it (the checkers' own words are in their run journals)
fields.errors: the ERRORS_AND_SOLUTIONS.md entries (M ids) the row names
fields.fix_commits: the git commits of the fix (each must exist in git)
fields.fix_note: the fix as written (for a step-8 row: its fix_commit text, Railway job ids included)
fields.runs_on: where the fix runs: live, beta or branch (every fix commit an ancestor of that site's commit in deployed_commits.json; scripts/recheck_doc.py --sites), not_code (records only), none (no fix commit)
fields.author_test: how the fix's author tested it (empty for a step-8 row: see evidence)
fields.open_row: for an open row: its owner row in PLAN.md or EXEC.md (rule 1), empty when it has none
fields.recheck: the re-check rounds that tested it: {run, round, verdict (fixed, partly, not_fixed, cannot_tell), date, evidence}; a step-8 row's earlier test-outs are in tested_out_by as written
fields.recheck_action: what a re-check reproduces and looks for (a step-8 row: its step8_action)
fields.tested_out_by: the test-out by another agent, as the step-8 ledger wrote it; none when there was none
fields.evidence: where the facts of the row come from
fields.from: step8_ledger (moved 2026-11-24), scan (the scan of 2026-11-24) or fix (entered with its fix)
fields.step8_fate: a step-8 row only: its fate as that ledger wrote it

rows.area: Publisher: berkas events terbit ulang bila isi aksi korporasi berubah (ERRORS M567)
rows.title: An events file was not republished when a corporate action's content changed without a new row, date or load time
rows.finding: ERRORS M567 symptom: the publisher republishes a ticker's events file only when its stamp changes (row count, last event date, last ingestion_time; publisher.py EVENT_STAMPS_SQL, changed_events). An edit of a row's ratio or exercise price that keeps those three (an UPDATE outside the Stockbit round) left the events file and its broker basis on the old terms while the actions file carried the new ones: the Screener's badge and the Backtest would disagree.
rows.author_test: tests/test_publisher.py test_an_event_row_whose_content_changes_republishes_its_ticker_only (fails without the digest); publisher 269 passed; EXPLAIN ANALYZE on dev 1.26 s
rows.recheck_action: Change one corporate action row's ratio or exercise price without changing the row count, the last date or ingestion_time (on a copy or a fake database): the next run republishes that ticker's events file and measures its basis again, and nothing else; a run with nothing changed publishes nothing. Collateral: the run's time, the first run after the deploy republishes every events file once.
